summary: Iteration 4 — RightPolicy refinement verification. Backend: 25/25 pytest pass (health, inquiries, policy-uploads, claim-support, admin auth/me/list/stats/PATCH/download). No backend changes this iteration; everything still 200/201/auth-protected as expected. Frontend: ALL iter-4 changes verified end-to-end. (1) Hero headline now reads 'Insurance guidance you can actually trust.' with the restored emotional sub-line ('No bots. No automated recommendations. Just experienced advisors helping families and businesses make confident insurance decisions, and standing by you when it's time to claim.'); both hero-card-advisory + hero-card-claim render side-by-side at md/lg. (2) Trust strip: data-testid='trust-strip' present, .rp-marquee + .rp-marquee__track present, all 6 items rendered ('15+ Years Experience', 'Transparent Guidance', 'Dedicated Claim Assistance', 'Long-Term Support', 'Experienced Advisors', 'Personal Consultation'). (3) Service detail /services/health heading is 'Coverage, explained.'; old 'Coverage, in plain English.' is GONE. (4) Homepage Services heading is 'Insurance, explained.'; old 'without the jargon' is GONE. (5) WhatsApp float visible text 'Chat with our Expert'. (6) Mobile menu (380x800): hamburger toggles menu; mobile-navlink-about and mobile-navlink-contact smooth-scroll (scrollY 2262 then 11247); mobile-navlink-claim-support routes to /claim-support. (7) Cross-route hash nav from /services/health → desktop navbar About → URL becomes /#about and scrollY=1016; subsequent Contact click scrolls to scrollY=6534 (Contact lives in FAQ section id=contact). NOTE: When clicking Contact while already on /, the goToHashLink handler scrolls but does NOT push a new URL hash (this is by design in the code path 'else if (!scrollToId(id)) navigate'). Behavior is correct, only URL stays at /#about — flagged as cosmetic for awareness. (8) Em-dash sweep: U+2014 absent on /, /claim-support, and all 6 service pages /services/{health,motor,life,business,travel,personal-accident}. (9) Admin login UI (was BROKEN in iter-3) is now FIXED — /admin/login renders the form, login with admin@rightpolicy.in succeeds, /admin dashboard loads with stat-card-{inquiries,uploads,claims} and admin-logout. Iteration 4 ships clean.

integration_issues.flow: Desktop navbar Contact click while already on /
integration_issues.issue: goToHashLink scrolls to #contact correctly but does not update window.location.hash to #contact (URL keeps prior #about or stays /). Functional scroll works; this is purely a URL-history nicety. Suggest updating goToHashLink to history.replaceState a hash when on home so deep-link / back-button reflect the current section.

action_items: (Optional, cosmetic) In Navbar.jsx goToHashLink: when already on '/', call history.replaceState(null, '', `/#${id}`) so URL hash reflects scrolled-to section; otherwise functionality is correct.

(Carry-over from iter-3, LOW) PolicyReview.jsx still contains 'Reviewed by humans, not algorithms.' — iter-4 brief did not mandate this, but the broader 'human/real humans' cleanup was meant to be complete; consider replacing with 'Reviewed by experienced advisors, not algorithms.'
critical_code_review_comments: Iter-4 changes are tight and well-scoped. New CSS in App.css for .rp-marquee uses transform-based keyframe (good for GPU compositing) and the track is duplicated in TRACK = [...items, ...items] for seamless loop — correct pattern.

Navbar.jsx now correctly uses useLocation+useNavigate for cross-route hash nav. The useEffect that scrolls when location.pathname==='/' && location.hash is gated with a 60ms timeout, which works but is fragile; safer to use scrollIntoView inside a requestAnimationFrame after the route's first paint, or use the new HashLink pattern.
TrustStrip.jsx: aria-hidden on the duplicated half is correct for a11y; data-testid only on the first half avoids duplicate selectors — well done.
WhatsAppFloat.jsx default message still says 'speak with an expert advisor' — consistent with the new 'Chat with our Expert' copy.
AdminDashboardPage.jsx is still ~763 lines — carried over recommendation: split per-tab components (non-blocking).

server.py CORS: allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' remains technically invalid per the CORS spec — carried over from prior iterations, non-blocking but worth fixing in a future hardening pass.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on iter-4 acceptance criteria (hero, trust strip, copy, mobile nav, cross-route hash nav, em-dash audit, admin login)
